items.explanation: バ is 'ba': ハ ('ha') with dakuten. It is the same sound as hiragana ば. The two small ticks ゛ are called dakuten. They make the consonant voiced, meaning your vocal cords buzz: k becomes g, s becomes z, t becomes d, and h becomes b. Touch your throat while saying 'k' and then 'g' to feel the difference.
items.mnemonic: ハ plus two ticks for buzzing vocal cords: 'ha' starts to buzz and becomes 'ba'.

items.mnemonic: ヒ plus two ticks for buzzing vocal cords: 'hi' starts to buzz and becomes 'bi'.
